name: City of Bath
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Bath is a city in Somerset, in southwest England, set in the Avon valley about 156 km west of London. Romans built a bathing complex and temple here around 60 AD, drawn by its hot springs. In the Georgian era, architects such as John Wood the Elder lined the hillsides with honey-coloured stone terraces, including the sweeping Royal Crescent, which still stand beside the ancient baths.
